timeline.text: Artem's blood sugar lived only inside one app on his phone — nothing else could see it.
Not the family kiosk, not a future alert — nothing outside that app could reach the number.
Now a systemd service polls the reading on a schedule, backing off instead of hammering the server.
It opens a read-only feed any authorized app can call — even one scoped to a single device.
That feed now reports four numbers every time: value, trend, level, and age.
